summary: All 6 target claims from counter-evidence-plan.md were put side by side and actively tested. 3 held essentially as stated (Ch.8 dynamics gap — strengthened from unsourced judgment to evidence-backed; LeKiwi buildability — strengthened by an independent builder account; Bittle 'not a dead project' — lineage survives though the specific 2020 product is discontinued). 2 did not hold as stated (SO-ARM100's ~$115 headline cost, which describes a bare-frame component rather than a complete build and should be revised to ~$200-230; Bittle's 'genuinely exercises IK, not pre-baked motions' claim, contradicted by direct firmware inspection showing on-device gait execution is precomputed table playback with IK only used offline at design time, and the claim's own cited README source doesn't currently contain the attributed language). 1 (blanket hobbyist-feasibility) holds on substance but needed its 'turnkey' tone corrected given independent friction reports. LeKiwi's $660 figure vs. a lower $482-499 reference BOM, and the independence of two LeKiwi/SO-ARM100 aggregator sourcing sites, remain genuinely unresolved rather than falsified. No fundamental flaw was found in the original brief's sourcing chain, so no bounce to research-brief; the counter-evidence side was substantive and evidence-based across every target claim, so no bounce to counter-evidence.
